title: Research: source-bind R437 ordinary coupling at c=1/576 (no κ claim)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The old C0 program fails the complete recurrence at `c=1/576`. R437's actual paid program passes it, including the full bad-class fallback. This package establishes a **source-relative ordinary-rate implication and finite source-adapter audit**, with **no supported multiplication κ increase**.

Two exact engines enclose the new moment at `.9999983130605053632871630546…`, versus `1.0000087717216952679207496066…` for the old source. Conditional on the changed program's uniform physical refinement/cost premises, the ordinary saving is `a=575/331776 ≈ .001733097029321`. The proof retains the `10^6` power majorant, original-width stock and eventual fit, both padded C0 returns, and complete wrapper coefficient `4283584 C`.

The adapter reconstructs 903,456 paid requests from the actual R437 word, owners and residual idles; all 7,814,016 local-call events pass the retained chronology controller. The new rank-34 idle is consumed by the actual numerical callback and controlled CALL/RETURN fixture. A separate reduced physical fixture exercises `Profile(1,576)` and both padded returns. These are explicitly separate finite experiments, not one complete GL64 production cohort.

The fixed retimed T360 root remains unchanged. The prospective physical synthetic transfer retains both root/router terms and its normalization; its displayed saving `.001725225817793` is not a multiplication κ. No selected-frontier or shared-code change is made.

## Task and overlap

Explicit user-assigned scope `r437-ordinary-t360`: R437 into the stronger ordinary coupling, then joint retimed T360. Scope is unchanged; the bounded outcome is enabling **LOCAL_PROGRESS**. Base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6.

Exact inputs:

- [PR3647](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3647): `36ff441479ff9c7e70d83f0becccd44da50effb8`.
- [PR3562](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3562): `abb93be8b9ceca07a2b17f3a97db7bb6b074271d`.
- [PR3682](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3682): `431e6c6023ef352c41696469de7fb614cd4ded8c`; its endpoint matches [PR3653](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3653) at `607a09ff441c79b215a8127a81f4cc70021d0d9b`: `.001730418899766071163804 - 10^-46 - 10^-70`. These pending public claims remain distinct from selected admission.
- Physical root/support/Fourier source pins and all retained byte hashes are recorded in the package.

The submission refresh covered 394 open PR bodies and 2,469 Discussion records at 2026-10-18 15:24 UTC, with no pagination warnings. PR3668 overlaps the scalar histogram comparison. The [active independent word audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19019098) concerns the local identity and single-change controls; this package adds the ordinary recurrence/constants and source-bound adapter. Coverage is not a novelty proof.

## Validation

Standard library, CPython 3.14.5; reproduction entry point:

```sh
python3 -B research/r437-ordinary-t360/verify.py
```

- Bounded replay passes exact moments/constants, actual catalogue/controller and rank-34 gate, physical wrapper provenance/cleanup/reuse, and the exact Count width predicate. Wrong-parent, foreign-program and wrong-source controls reject.
- The committed Git-free export passes the same checks; 128 retained source mappings match their exact Git blobs.
- The pinned R437 author cold verifier passed all 13 commands in 41.76 seconds with the exclusive replay lock. Raw logs and receipts are retained; replay is not independent supplier admission.
- Fresh clean-context **Astra medium** review returned **CONCLUDE: YES** for scientific commit `0c770abd231422a24cc4aecd45509440946b0a3c`, independently reran the bounded checks, and checked all 13 cold-log hashes. Review is retained under `reviews/`; this is AI review, not human or formal approval. Subsequent changes concern publication documentation and evidence only.

`REPLAY.json` documents the self-contained archive workflow. It needs no runtime network or foreign Git objects and does not opt into the optional catalogue-based `VERIFY.json` registry. No full GL64 payload, combined production cohort, T360 admission replay, all-size refinement proof, Lean or Docker was run. The interrupted exploratory full Count boundary bisection is disclosed; the final check uses its exact power predicate plus small actual selector calls.

## Open next questions

See the package README and PROOF. The first unresolved obligation is **one authenticated production R437 ordinary/native/router cohort**, including its complete GL64 program and uniform changed-source refinement/cost proof. T360 uniform height/online precision/hosting and the complete Gaussian/CRT/product/recovery join remain open. Finite stock or prefix certificates do not discharge those obligations, and unknown costs are not zero.
